old_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of a large, faceted diamond rotating slowly against a plain, dark gray background. The diamond is predominantly yellowish-green with hints of white, reflecting light in various directions, creating a shimmering effect. As the diamond rotates, its facets catch the light, revealing intricate cuts and reflections that highlight its brilliance and clarity. The camera remains steady throughout, focusing on the diamond's surface, which occasionally catches the light, producing a sparkling effect. The background remains static, ensuring all attention is on the diamond's movement and the play of light on its surface. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, emphasizing the solitary beauty of the gemstone.

caption: The video showcases a macro close-up of a single faceted, pale yellow-green gemstone resting on a smooth dark-gray reflective surface, its mirror image duplicated below. The stone stays centered and in contact with the surface while its orientation turns gradually and continuously across the excerpt. The broad, bright table facet, oriented toward the viewer from the upper-left, rotates progressively edge-on, narrowing into a strip as the right-hand facets come into view. Colored dispersion flashes migrate over the facets, a violet glow at the lower edge becoming blue, then cyan-green, with a magenta edge emerging on the right. The reflection below tracks these same rotational and color changes, confirming it belongs to the turning stone. No translational movement occurs; the change reads purely as rotation within the visible segment.
